# Historical save fixture

`save_v1_reference.flsave` uses the exact published Phase 8 little-endian v1
format, including a faction, leader NPC, territory, mission, old allocator marks,
clock and all RNG words. It intentionally has no generated baseline so it stays
small and independently readable. Normal tests only read this fixed binary.

SHA-256: `db23ea06ef1008bbe82674d1f3a6e37abea991d2d60087c596488d6a364d4a3c`.

`create_v1_reference.ps1` records its explicit primitive/field encoding without
calling the current C++ serializer. Run it only when intentionally maintaining
fixture provenance; do not regenerate fixtures to hide compatibility failures.
The migration test checks preserved semantic values and verifies that the frozen
v1 test encoder reproduces the independent fixture byte for byte. Additional
generated-world migration tests exercise all three supported generator versions.

An attempt to generate fixtures through a temporary Phase 8 executable was
blocked by Windows Application Control. That executable was not used, and no
security policy was changed or bypassed. The independent wire fixture and frozen
v1 field encoder provide reproducible coverage without requiring that program.

## Phase 9 v2 fixture

`save_v2_phase9.flsave` is an unmodified real Phase 9 tool save (seed 12345,
generator 3, tick 1152000 / 30 days), copied before Phase 10 changes. It contains
468 operation records, 8 pending operations, all 22 generated major NPCs and
runtime resource/RNG/allocator/scheduler states. Size: 1012765 bytes.
SHA-256: `2e5e5772efdf86446261028aee9679179a01f5a5d328590d3bf187afdc899e92`.
Tests read this fixed v2 binary and verify that all eleven historical section
payloads survive migration byte for byte before exercising resumed simulation.
Do not regenerate the fixture with the current encoder to mask incompatibility.

## Phase 10 v3 fixture

`save_v3_phase10.flsave` is the actual Phase 10 seed-12345 day-30 save, copied
before Phase 11 implementation: 1013953 bytes, 468 operation records, eight
pending operations, persisted NPC semantic assignments/schedules and RNG state.
SHA-256: `1c920638681da448228c3e91a9a167f06a4a77996889164ffefc7930dbc0e0c2`.
Phase 11 tests load it under v4, verify deterministic initialization and consume
future operations without replaying past consequences. Do not regenerate it
with the current writer to mask compatibility regressions.

## Phase 11 v4 fixture

`save_v4_phase11.flsave` was generated by the pre-repair Phase 11 executable on
2026-10-17 before any production edit for local resistance:
`build/faultline_sim.exe --seed 12345 --days 30 --save tests/fixtures/save_v4_phase11.flsave`.
Size: 1023945 bytes; 508 operations, four pending, 50 territory transitions,
StateHash c5c174fb61dc193, generator 3, tick 1152000.
SHA-256: `f788cfd61eee45dc97790607c86ab5bc119deea6b225e0863092df77e4ef2dfb`.
V5 tests check preserved historical authority and bytes, zero initial resistance,
and deterministic future continuation. Do not regenerate it with the current writer.

## Phase 11 v5 fixture

`save_v5_phase11.flsave` is the unmodified actual Phase 11 repaired day-30 save,
copied from build/phase11-repair-day30.flsave before the Phase 12 build. It has
SaveFormatVersion 5, seed 12345, generator 3, tick 1152000, persisted resistance
and pending faction operations. It is not emitted by the current v6 writer.
SHA-256: `474246048820a05eb2e718a878598579f2af030af9336b89bea6afd7fb74cb3b`.
The market suite compares every old section payload byte for byte, verifies zero
retroactive revenue, then continues the migration alongside a v6 reload for a year.


## Phase 12 v6 fixture

`save_v6_phase12.flsave` was emitted by the unmodified Phase 12 executable before
Phase 13 sources were built:
`build/faultline_sim.exe --seed 12345 --days 30 --save tests/fixtures/save_v6_phase12.flsave`.
It is 1,025,498 bytes, tick 1152000, generator 3, 508 operations (four pending),
719 market updates and historical StateHash dad9074a462b8212.
SHA-256: `54ad68de755f3339a4f87111d07734ac49f2726a903ea99b9b43ceb642ec9236`.
Phase 13 checks every original section payload unchanged through v7 migration,

fixture with the new writer.

## Phase 13 v7 fixture

`save_v7_phase13.flsave` was already present untracked when Phase 14 resumed.
It was inspected with the unmodified Phase 13 `faultline_savecheck --inspect`
before the new serializer was built: v7, generator 3, seed 12345, tick 38400,
StateHash ab44633b2677f8ec, Validation PASS. Size: 971960 bytes.
SHA-256: `83dbd556987aaa4852de0314c6f3181b24890aeaead3ef8e254efaf40d98c6ef`.
Exact original creation command is not recorded;
this is a real Phase 13 format day-one runtime save, not a completed-history save.
Phase 14 preserves its bytes and compares all fifteen old section payloads through
v8 migration, then verifies deterministic continuation. Do not regenerate it.

## Phase 15 v8 fixture

`save_v8_phase14.flsave` is the authentic Phase 14 v8-format save generated from
the unmodified Phase 14 StoryGraph writer (`faultline_story.exe --seed 12345 --fixture-prologue --save`).
Produced in a temporary git worktree at commit `0aab7c4` with Phase 15 source files excluded
(see docs/PHASE15_VERIFICATION.md for provenance). It contains Seed 12345, GeneratorVersion 3,
SaveFormatVersion 8, tick 56064000 (48 months), StateHash `7c4539b8c6002849` (FAULTLINE.state.v10).
The fixture validates PASS under Phase 14 savecheck and migrates to v9 under Phase 15 with
MissionSimulation initialized from defaults. Size: 1006078 bytes.
SHA-256: `df1574a61f4005a182a7bf8dec87e7fbca4993a8076dcae9df65a0c947376f08`.
A `.gitattributes` rule (`*.flsave -text binary`) was added to prevent CRLF
corruption of binary fixtures by `core.autocrlf=true`. The previous reconstructed/v9-stripped
fixture was 2028838 bytes with SHA-256 `6a3d6cbe26bdc962ad94e3b5d3c59d9c01323118af76979810030ac98ed23708`
and failed Phase 14 savecheck ("Not a FAULTLINE save").
